# 銅符鐵券

**ID:** KR5i0040
**Date (file):** 2015-08-29 17:52:25.889043
**Base edition:** CK-KZ

## Authors / Editors
- DZJY  銅符鐵券

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*The Bronze Tally and Iron Charter*

compiled by [彭好古](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E5%A5%BD%E5%8F%A4) (Péng Hàogǔ, *hào* 一壑居士 Yīhè jūshì), dated **己亥仲夏 = mid-summer 1599**

A late-Wàn-lì-era compendium of *fúzhuàn* 符篆 (talismanic seals) and *jīndān* operational formulas assembled by **Péng Hàogǔ** — the same Húběi inner-alchemy editor responsible for [KR5i0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0029) *Lónghǔ shàng jīng xuán jiě*. The work takes its title from the legend (preserved in the *Liè xiān zhuàn*) that **Lán Gōng** 蘭公 of Qūfù, in cultivating filial piety, was visited by an Imperial Star Perfected styling himself **Xiàotì wáng** 孝悌王, who descended to his house and gave him a *Jīn dān bǎo jīng* 金丹寶經, *Tóng fú* 銅符 (bronze tally), and *Tiě quàn* 鐵券 (iron charter) — to be transmitted onward to **Chénmǔ** Dānyáng-Huángtáng, and from her to the Perfected Lord Xǔ Xùn 許祖. Péng's compilation re-presents the legend's named scripture under the *Tóng fú tiě quàn* title and arranges it under the standard alchemical headings of *sān yuán yào wù huǒ hòu* 三元藥物火候 ("Three-Origin medicine-substance and fire-phasing").

**Abstract**

A late-Wàn-lì compendium of inner-alchemical operational instructions framed under the legendary *Tóngfú tiěquàn* of Lán Gōng 蘭公 and Xǔ Xùn — i.e., located within the **Jìngmíng zhōngxiào dào** 淨明忠孝道 (Pure-Bright Loyalty-and-Filiality) tradition centred on Xǔ Xùn (cf. [KR5i0041](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0041) *Tài shàng líng bǎo jìng míng zōng jiào lù*). The collection's distinctive feature is its programmatic willingness to publish the operational formula in plain language, against the conventional alchemical rule of secrecy: Péng explicitly defends "the formula is sought by heart-attainment, nine in ten get it; by paper-attainment, none — yet I have collected it in paper, hoping that one student will catch the fish-and-rabbit and let go the bamboo-trap." Composition dated *jǐhài* mid-summer = **summer 1599**, the same season as Péng's preface to [KR5i0029](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5i/KR5i0029). The two are companion productions of his Húběi alchemical-editorial circle.

For Péng Hàogǔ's broader project see [彭好古](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BD%AD%E5%A5%BD%E5%8F%A4).
